name: anchor
description: Anchor: a local token governor and dashboard for Claude Code and Codex: stops a big session from re-paying an expired cache, prompts /compact and /clear as context grows, a status line with context and cache time, lean start, token tools from the web ranked for your usage, token skills for the Claude app and Cowork; plus a skill bridge that brings Claude skills to Codex, live agents, sessions, skills manager and usage resets. Runs only on 127.0.0.1; no data leaves your computer.
